title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

series.title: Three Kingdoms 8: Reunification of the Three Kingdoms Under Jin

fullText.simplified:
第四章、信任

    姜维带兵攻打天水城，告诉太守马真他已经投降诸葛亮了，还要马真也投降。
    马真大骂道：“我就知道你是会投降的人！真该早点儿杀了你！”他朝城上的士兵大喊道：“放箭！放箭！别让姜维活着离开！”
    箭雨飞落，攻城战在夜色中打了整整一夜，直到快天亮时，姜维才在马真的骂声中退军离去。
    诸葛亮和赵云一直在远处的山上看着城门这边。姜维离开后，他们下了山。
    “马真太不信任姜维了，居然这么轻易就相信姜维投降了！”赵云感叹。
    “如果他真的信任姜维，姜维就不会只是一个小小的守将了。”诸葛亮说：“这个人长得真像姜维，你从哪儿找的？”
    赵云笑道：“他和姜维其实只像了五分，是因为天黑，马真看不清，不然他应该能认出这个姜维是假的。”
    诸葛亮点头道：“现在我们可以去季城了。”
    天刚亮，季城城上，真正的姜维正在查看军情。忽然他发现围在城下的蜀军正在退军，主力大军已走远，后面只跟着一队拉着马车运送粮草的小兵。姜维看着那几十车粮草，心中一动，带兵追了出来，他想抢那些粮草。当他正要追上粮草军队时，大路旁边的小树林里突然冲出来一队蜀军，领队的人是赵云。姜维心中一惊，知道自己中计了，急忙退兵回城，但等城门出现在眼前时，他又发现城上已经站满了蜀军士兵——蜀军已经攻破季城了。姜维的心凉了一半，只能一边和追来的赵云打，一边往天水城的方向跑。好不容易跑远了，赵云不见了，刚想停下来休息，又杀出来一队蜀军，又是一场苦战。等最后逃出来的时候，姜维的兵已经全没了。
    他一个人回到天水城下，站在紧闭的城门外大喊：“我是姜维，快开城门！”
    马真得到消息，跑到城上一看，发现真的又是姜维，大声骂道：“你还敢回来？你已投降诸葛亮了，现在是想骗我打开城门，好让蜀军冲进来吗？”
    “马大人，您说什么？我刚从季城过来……”姜维急忙解释，但马真完全不听，他大手一挥，命令道：“放箭！别让他逃了——杀了他！杀了他！”
    姜维还想解释，但城上已经飞下来一片箭雨。幸好他躲得及时，不然当场就死了。他既生气又失望，骑马向南边跑了。他跑进一片树林，阳光照在林间，他慢慢冷静下来，心里却一片悲伤。不被马真信任的失望让他心寒极了，再想到季城里不知生死的母亲，他的眼泪控制不住地流了下来。
fullText.traditional:
第四章、信任

    姜維帶兵攻打天水城，告訴太守馬真他已經投降諸葛亮了，還要馬真也投降。
    馬真大罵道：“我就知道你是會投降的人！真該早點兒殺了你！”他朝城上的士兵大喊道：“放箭！放箭！別讓姜維活著離開！”
    箭雨飛落，攻城戰在夜色中打了整整一夜，直到快天亮時，姜維才在馬真的罵聲中退軍離去。
    諸葛亮和趙雲一直在遠處的山上看著城門這邊。姜維離開後，他們下了山。
    “馬真太不信任姜維了，居然這麼輕易就相信姜維投降了！”趙雲感嘆。
    “如果他真的信任姜維，姜維就不會只是一個小小的守將了。”諸葛亮說：“這個人長得真像姜維，你從哪兒找的？”
    趙雲笑道：“他和姜維其實只像了五分，是因為天黑，馬真看不清，不然他應該能認出這個姜維是假的。”
    諸葛亮點頭道：“現在我們可以去季城了。”
    天剛亮，季城城上，真正的姜維正在查看軍情。忽然他發現圍在城下的蜀軍正在退軍，主力大軍已走遠，後面只跟著一隊拉著馬車運送糧草的小兵。姜維看著那幾十車糧草，心中一動，帶兵追了出來，他想搶那些糧草。當他正要追上糧草軍隊時，大路旁邊的小樹林裡突然衝出來一隊蜀軍，領隊的人是趙雲。姜維心中一驚，知道自己中計了，急忙退兵回城，但等城門出現在眼前時，他又發現城上已經站滿了蜀軍士兵——蜀軍已經攻破季城了。姜維的心涼了一半，只能一邊和追來的趙雲打，一邊往天水城的方向跑。好不容易跑遠了，趙雲不見了，剛想停下來休息，又殺出來一隊蜀軍，又是一場苦戰。等最後逃出來的時候，姜維的兵已經全沒了。
    他一個人回到天水城下，站在緊閉的城門外大喊：“我是姜維，快開城門！”
    馬真得到消息，跑到城上一看，發現真的又是姜維，大聲罵道：“你還敢回來？你已投降諸葛亮了，現在是想騙我打開城門，好讓蜀軍衝進來嗎？”
    “馬大人，您說什麼？我剛從季城過來……”姜維急忙解釋，但馬真完全不聽，他大手一揮，命令道：“放箭！別讓他逃了——殺了他！殺了他！”
    姜維還想解釋，但城上已經飛下來一片箭雨。幸好他躲得及時，不然當場就死了。他既生氣又失望，騎馬向南邊跑了。他跑進一片樹林，陽光照在林間，他慢慢冷靜下來，心裡卻一片悲傷。不被馬真信任的失望讓他心寒極了，再想到季城裡不知生死的母親，他的眼淚控制不住地流了下來。

sentences.simplified: 现在是想骗我打开城门，好让蜀军冲进来吗？”
sentences.traditional: 現在是想騙我打開城門，好讓蜀軍衝進來嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shì xiǎng piàn wǒ dǎ kāi chéng mén hǎo ràng shǔ jūn chōng jìn lái ma
sentences.english: Now are you trying to deceive me into opening the city gates so that the Shu army can rush in?”

sentences.simplified: “马大人，您说什么？我刚从季城过来……”姜维急忙解释，
sentences.traditional: “馬大人，您說什麼？我剛從季城過來……”姜維急忙解釋，
sentences.pinyin: mǎ dà ren nín shuō shén me wǒ gāng cóng jì chéng guò lái jiāng wéi jí máng jiě shì
sentences.english: “Lord Ma, what did you say? I just returned from Jicheng …” Jiang Wei explained hurriedly.

sentences.simplified: 但马真完全不听，他大手一挥，命令道：“放箭！别让他逃了——杀了他！杀了他！”
sentences.traditional: 但馬真完全不聽，他大手一揮，命令道：“放箭！別讓他逃了——殺了他！殺了他！”
sentences.pinyin: dàn mǎ zhēn wán quán bù tīng tā dà shǒu yì huī mìng lìng dào fàng jiàn bié ràng tā táo le shā le tā shā le tā
sentences.english: But Ma Zhen completely ignored him. With a wave of his hand, he commanded, “Shoot your arrows! Don’t let him escape—kill him! Kill him!”

sentences.simplified: 姜维还想解释，但城上已经飞下来一片箭雨。
sentences.traditional: 姜維還想解釋，但城上已經飛下來一片箭雨。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng wéi hái xiǎng jiě shì dàn chéng shang yǐ jīng fēi xià lái yí piàn jiàn yǔ
sentences.english: Jiang Wei wanted to explain, but a rain of arrows had already flown down from the city walls.

sentences.simplified: 幸好他躲得及时，不然当场就死了。
sentences.traditional: 幸好他躲得及時，不然當場就死了。
sentences.pinyin: xìng hǎo tā duǒ de jí shí bù rán dāng chǎng jiù sǐ le
sentences.english: Luckily, he got out of the way just in time, otherwise he would have died there.

sentences.simplified: 他既生气又失望，骑马向南边跑了。
sentences.traditional: 他既生氣又失望，騎馬向南邊跑了。
sentences.pinyin: tā jì shēng qì yòu shī wàng qí mǎ xiàng nán bian pǎo le
sentences.english: He was both angry and disappointed, and rode his horse south.

sentences.simplified: 他跑进一片树林，阳光照在林间，他慢慢冷静下来，心里却一片悲伤。
sentences.traditional: 他跑進一片樹林，陽光照在林間，他慢慢冷靜下來，心裡卻一片悲傷。
sentences.pinyin: tā pǎo jìn yí piàn shù lín yáng guāng zhào zài lín jiān tā màn man lěng jìng xià lai xīn li què yí piàn bēi shāng
sentences.english: He ran into some woods, where the sunlight shone through the trees. He slowly calmed down, but his heart was filled with sadness.

sentences.simplified: 不被马真信任的失望让他心寒极了，
sentences.traditional: 不被馬真信任的失望讓他心寒極了，
sentences.pinyin: bú bèi mǎ zhēn xìn rèn de shī wàng ràng tā xīn hán jí le
sentences.english: That Ma Zhen didn’t trust him made him bitterly disappointed.

sentences.simplified: 再想到季城里不知生死的母亲，他的眼泪控制不住地流了下来。
sentences.traditional: 再想到季城裡不知生死的母親，他的眼淚控制不住地流了下來。
sentences.pinyin: zài xiǎng dào jì chéng lǐ bù zhī shēng sǐ de mǔ qīn tā de yǎn lèi kòng zhì bú zhù de liú le xià lái
sentences.english: Then he thought of his mother in Jicheng, who he didn’t know was dead or alive, and his tears flowed uncontrollably.

sentence_translations: Chapter 4: Trust
Jiang Wei led his troops to attack Tianshui.
He told the governor Ma Zhen that he had already surrendered to Zhuge Liang and also wanted Ma Zhen to surrender.
Ma Zhen cursed loudly, “I knew you were the type to surrender! I should have killed you earlier!”
He shouted to the soldiers on the city wall, “Shoot your arrows! Shoot your arrows! Don’t let Jiang Wei leave alive!”
A rain of arrows fell.
The assault on the city continued through the night, ..
.. and it wasn’t until dawn that Jiang Wei retreated from the battlefield amidst Ma Zhen’s curses.
Zhuge Liang and Zhao Yun were watching the city gates from a distant mountain the whole time.
After Jiang Wei left, they came down from the mountain.
“Ma Zhen is too distrustful of Jiang Wei. He was too quick to believe that Jiang Wei surrendered!” Zhao Yun exclaimed.
“If he truly trusted Jiang Wei, Jiang Wei wouldn’t just be a minor garrison commander.”
Zhuge Liang said, “This person really looks like Jiang Wei. Where did you find him?”
Zhao Yun smiled and said, “He only bears a slight resemblance to Jiang Wei,
It’s because it was dark and Ma Zhen couldn’t see clearly.
Otherwise, he would have been able to tell that this Jiang Wei is a fake.”
Zhuge Liang nodded and said, “Now we can go to Jicheng.”
At dawn, on the walls of Jicheng, the real Jiang Wei was inspecting the military situation.
Suddenly, he noticed that the Shu army surrounding the city was retreating.
The main forces had already moved far away, with only a small group of soldiers trailing behind, pulling carts to transport provisions.
Seeing those dozens of carts filled with provisions, Jiang Wei had a sudden idea.
He led his troops in pursuit, intending to seize those provisions.
Just as he was about to catch up with the supply convoy, a troop of Shu soldiers suddenly charged out from a small grove beside the road.
The person leading them was Zhao Yun.
Jiang Wei was taken aback and realized that he had fallen into a trap.
He hurriedly ordered a retreat back to the city, but by the time the city gates came into view, ..
.. he found that the city walls were already filled with Shu soldiers—the Shu army had already broken into Jicheng.
Jiang Wei felt a chill in his heart. He had no choice but to fight off the pursuing Zhao Yun while making a run for Tianshui.
With much difficulty, he managed to run far away. Zhao Yun was nowhere to be seen.
Just as he was about to stop and rest, another troop of Shu soldiers appeared, leading to yet another tough battle.
By the time he finally escaped, Jiang Wei’s troops were completely gone.
Alone, he returned to the gates of Tianshui and shouted at the tightly closed gates, “I am Jiang Wei, open the gates now!”
Upon receiving the news, Ma Zhen rushed to the top of the city wall.
Seeing that it was indeed Jiang Wei again, he shouted angrily, ..
.. “You dare to come back? You have already surrendered to Zhuge Liang.
Now are you trying to deceive me into opening the city gates so that the Shu army can rush in?”
“Lord Ma, what did you say? I just returned from Jicheng …” Jiang Wei explained hurriedly.
But Ma Zhen completely ignored him. With a wave of his hand, he commanded, “Shoot your arrows! Don’t let him escape—kill him! Kill him!”
Jiang Wei wanted to explain, but a rain of arrows had already flown down from the city walls.
Luckily, he got out of the way just in time, otherwise he would have died there.
He was both angry and disappointed, and rode his horse south.
He ran into some woods, where the sunlight shone through the trees. He slowly calmed down, but his heart was filled with sadness.
That Ma Zhen didn’t trust him made him bitterly disappointed.
Then he thought of his mother in Jicheng, who he didn’t know was dead or alive, and his tears flowed uncontrollably.
